title: Vecchia zimarra
subtitle: Colline says goodbye to his old coat before pawning it for Mimì, then sends Schaunard out to leave her alone with Rodolfo, La bohème, Act 4

passages.label: Vecchia zimarra, senti ((19), Allegretto moderato e triste): the coat must climb the sacred mount; it never bowed to the rich and powerful
Passar nelle tue tasche: philosophers and poets in its pockets; Ora che i giorni lieti fuggir, addio (molto rit.), then the piano (a tempo)
Schaunard, ognuno per diversa via (Meno): two kind deeds; io... questo! E tu... lasciali soli là!
Schaunard: Filosofo, ragioni! È ver!.. Vo via! (Andantino, A major)
Piano alone ((20), Andantino mosso, calmo, G major): the two friends leave Mimì and Rodolfo together

licences.source: Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, libretto of La bohème (1896)
licences.author: Luigi Illica (1857–1919) and Giuseppe Giacosa (1847–1906)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Ricordi vocal score.

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 258-261 (from figure (19) at the top of page 258 to page 261 system 3 bar 2, the bar before figure (21), 59 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Tempo from the printed metronome mark Allegretto moderato e triste ♩ = 63 at figure (19) (bar 1); the Meno (bar 28), the Andantino (bar 37) and the Andantino mosso at figure (20) (bar 43) carry no number and are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
